summary: Backend testing for Word Search (YouBelong). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_wordsearch.py (15 pytest cases) covering catalog, puzzle determinism, daily, placement integrity, progress save/idempotency, hard/nightmare/daily achievements, friend Flutter broadcast, and regressions (/games/dailies, /community/today, frankie demo-login). Initial run: 11 PASSED, 4 FAILED — all failures traced to a single MongoDB error in POST /api/games/wordsearch/progress/{user_id} (path-'id' conflict between $set and $setOnInsert in the upsert). Applied a minimal fix in server.py (removed id/created_at from $set; left them only in $setOnInsert). Re-ran the full suite — 15/15 PASSED. Word actually spells: verified by reconstructing each word from grid[r][c] across its placements list — all match. Hard completion broadcasts an achievement notification to maggie (verified in DB and via GET /api/notifications/{friend_id}). Daily completion sets is_daily=true on game_completions and grants the daily_challenge achievement. No deprecated Expo packages were tested (frontend not in scope).

critical.issue: FIXED. Upsert built a Mongo update that included `id` and `created_at` in BOTH `$set` (when `existing` was None) and `$setOnInsert`, causing every first-time save to fail with pymongo.errors.WriteError code 40 'Updating the path "id" would create a conflict at "id"'. Net effect: 500 on every initial save AND on every completion (points/achievements never recorded, friend Flutter never sent). Fix applied at /app/backend/server.py ~line 1183-1203: drop id/created_at from the $set payload and rely solely on $setOnInsert.

action_items: Review the fix at /app/backend/server.py (wordsearch_save_progress) — $set vs $setOnInsert separation. The same anti-pattern may exist in other game-progress endpoints (jigsaw_save_progress, trivia_save_progress, etc.) — recommend a quick grep for `$set` + `$setOnInsert` upserts that share keys.

Consider adding the 'first_game' achievement to the WordSearch tests if frankie's game_completions table is reset in production; the current suite cleans frankie's completions so the first wordsearch completion in a clean run also grants 'first_game' (tests do not assert this explicitly to avoid coupling to other game types).
Optional: surface a clearer error than 500 if any future Mongo write fails (wrap in try/except + 500 with structured message).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1183-1203 (wordsearch_save_progress) — original upsert mixed `id`/`created_at` in $set and $setOnInsert. Always keep insert-only fields out of $set.
word_search.py is clean: deterministic per-seed RNG, placements reconstructable, theme list = exactly 20 entries, all 4 difficulties (8/10/12/14, 6/8/10/12 words) match the spec.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. Tests temporarily add maggie as a friend of frankie (restored in finally), and per-test fixtures wipe frankie's wordsearch_progress, wordsearch game_completions, and hard/nightmare/daily_challenge achievements before AND after each completion test. DB returns to its pre-test state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_wordsearch.py uses synchronous PyMongo for DB inspection (reads MONGO_URL & DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env). It depends on frankie and maggie demo accounts existing (they do per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). If the friend Flutter test starts flaking, increase the time.sleep(0.3) after the POST. The 'first_game' achievement is not asserted because frankie's earlier game_completions in other game types may already have granted it.
rca_of_issue: RCA: In server.py wordsearch_save_progress, when no existing progress row was found, the code set doc['id']=nid() and doc['created_at']=now_iso(), then called update_one(..., {'$set': doc, '$setOnInsert': {'id': ..., 'created_at': ...}}, upsert=True). MongoDB forbids the same field path appearing in $set and $setOnInsert (error code 40, conflict). Reproduction: POST /api/games/wordsearch/progress/{any_uid} with any valid body for a NEW puzzle_id → 500 every time. Mitigation: keep insert-only fields exclusively under $setOnInsert; mutable fields under $set. Verified: re-ran the full 15-test pytest suite, all green.
